trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy — 54 of them — and the platinum drops when the last one unlocks. Treat it as the endgame goal, not an early one.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end — it's the game's first mission and usually the first trophy.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist — the big score — and get away with it.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every trophy, activity, collectible set and stranger strand. Expect this to be your last gold — plan for it from the start.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, drifts and near-misses all count. Chain them in busy areas to build the meter faster.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once: a race, drone race, shooting-range challenge, fishing, arcade game, bowling, meditation, hunting and cards.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges; accuracy and speed both matter, replay until every one is gold.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races — street races and track events count, each once.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and beat his score; try different bait in different spots.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one arcade cabinet from start to finish and see its ending. Any cabinet counts.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission — the end of his stranger strand.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete all eight stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more; track them as they appear on the map.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots — they're marked on the map; travel to each and sit.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting challenge by taking down the unique animal he asks for.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find collectible cards around Leonida and complete any three full sets; cards turn up in shops, in the world and as rewards.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 distinct locations; fast-travel to new regions and check in wherever you go.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Clear 50 challenges from the challenge list — stunts, races, combat tasks and more all count.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, raise the wanted level to four stars, then lose the cops and escape together.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping one continuous wanted level — don't let the heat drop between robberies.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of 100 distinct vehicles; the vehicle discovery log tracks what you've seen.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and eliminate five enemies before the slow-motion window ends.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave the VCIA building by an unconventional route — windows, roofs, service exits — not the front door.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tank encounter — take it on or take it down when it shows up.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Hit a jewelry store stealthily: no alarms, no guards alerted, clean getaway.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each one alive; plan approach and exit for each.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, take the cargo and lose the heat before the response closes in.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 named areas of Leonida; the map fills in as you travel — check regions you've missed.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs operating in Leonida.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find the bar with the view, and order a cocktail.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Crash through a vehicle showroom and drive a car straight out the front.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach the key story moment with your partner — the big set-piece you share.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game tracks choices toward 500 and some can't be undone; decide deliberately, since one playthrough can lock outcomes.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed on the second try — don't walk away after a failure.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's rare strange events; they're easy to miss, so watch the odd corners of the map.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Fence Marked Bills through contacts until $250,000 is laundered; big hauls count most.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida — clothes, guns, vehicles; go on a shopping spree if you finish the story short.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties around Leonida; check the real-estate map for the ones you need.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app; any ten discovered vehicles qualify.
trophies.source: Source: PlayStation — official GTA VI trophy list (make.fun kit, list dated 2026-11-18).
